import json
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('constructed-review')
config=json.loads(Path('.jev-review.json').read_text())
command=['python3',str(Path(config['runtime'])/'learn.py'),'activate','constructed-review/policy.json','--sanity','constructed-review/sanity','--assessment','constructed-review/live-assessment.json']
started=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
proc=subprocess.run(command,cwd=Path.cwd(),capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
record={'schemaVersion':1,'command':command,'cwd':str(Path.cwd()),'startedAt':started,'completedAt':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'exitCode':proc.returncode,'stdout':proc.stdout,'stderr':proc.stderr,'modelLaunched':False,'liveEvaluatorRerun':False}
with (root/'activation-command.json').open('x') as f:
    json.dump(record,f,indent=2)
    f.write('\\n')
if proc.stdout:
    with (root/'activation-result.json').open('x') as f:
        f.write(proc.stdout)
print(json.dumps(record,indent=2))
raise SystemExit(proc.returncode)
